Laura (ML Eng): Quick heads-up — during the int4 onboarding smoke for the new 32k model I keep seeing small token shifts when a long pref fill crosses a rotary phase boundary. reproducer attached below.
Sam P: Hmm, token shifts as in generation diverges vs fp16 baseline?
Laura (ML Eng): Yeah, exact same prompt, quantized int4 run vs fp16. Up to ~1-3 token position jitter (off-by-one/ -two) starting around position ~32760-32780. Happens after a long prefill and then streaming continuation.
Nik R: Can you paste the exact run invocation? also which kv config (stride/window)
Laura (ML Eng): repro:```bash
# run on dev node
python -m bench.run --model magnet-32k-int4 --prefill-file tests/longprefill/8k_concat.txt \
  --context-window 65536 --kv-prefill-stride 256 --quant-mode int4-packed --seed 42
```
Laura (ML Eng): Observed on both single-shard and 2-shard configs. Repro rate ~8/50 runs.
Nik R: Pasting a minimal diff of token IDs when it diverges:
```diff
- ... 12034,12035,12036,12037
+ ... 12034,12036,12037,12038
```
Nik R: Looks like a one-token slip after a boundary. Could be rotatory phase wrap or a misaligned memcpy during packed-int unpack at certain offsets.
Maria L: fwiw we saw similar jitter when interleaved prefill + window resize hits a 32k power-of-two boundary in earlier quant experiments. Try disabling interleaved prefill or bumping stride to 512.
Laura (ML Eng): I just ran with `--kv-prefill-stride 512` and `--disable-interleaved-prefill` — initial smoke 40 runs, 0/40 so far. promising.
CI Bot: build/bench-arm-run #1284 finished — all smoke tests passed (round 1).
Nik R: Could be a timing/hand-off race between prefill writer and streaming consumer when the ROPE phase index wraps. I'll add an internal debug counter around the kvcache handshake and dump pos-indices at that boundary.
Laura (ML Eng): Dump example (trimmed):```json
{"pos_before":32768, "pos_after":32769, "rope_phase_index":-1, "kv_checksum":"a1f3"}
```
Nik R: That negative rope_phase_index is suspicious. Might be int overflow when computing phase multiplication for the packed layout.
Sam P: Can we PR a guard (saturate phase index) as a quick mitigation? if it fixes flaky we can ship and bisect root cause after.
Nik R: Yeah I'll open a patch to clamp the computed phase before packing, run full fuzz. assigning to me: RDW-8237.
Laura (ML Eng): Filed RDW-8237, assigned to @Nik. I'll run a nightly sweep across longprefill corpus and report results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Infra Bot: node dev-04 GPU reclaimed for infra updates at 2026-03-23T03:12:00Z — tests might be flaky during window.
Maria L: Follow-up: if mitigation reduces repro but not eliminates, try `--context-window 70000` to avoid hitting exact wrap and see if it moves. also add an echo of the raw packed bytes for the offending kvcache slot.
Sam P: Thanks team. Laura, please paste a link to RDW-8237 when you have it and we can triage in tomorrow sync.
Laura (ML Eng): Will do — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-8237. Logging results in the ticket. Thanks all.
